notes.title: Update 1.6.3 - Part 3 Final Modifiers and VFX Overhaul
notes.notes: [p][/p][p]Hello again! This update finalises the changes to modifiers and introduces a new visual effect for all dropped items. [/p][p][/p][p]The final two modifiers allow enemies to rearm traps and summon walls to block your path. Some enemies will now fire a projectile at a spent trap to rearm it. This means that areas where you previously avoided traps are no longer safe. [/p][p][/p][p]Conversely, we have introduced enemies that can spawn walls in your path, forcing you to take a different route through the dungeons.[/p][p][/p][p]Several fixes have also been made to the logic to ensure the game runs smoothly. [/p][p][/p][p]VFX Overhaul is now finished: every modifier now has a unique updated VFX to make them stand out.  [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Mirrage[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30239964/5a8e8ed1749f4af00bab39f878b4542c2b63d694.png"][/img][/p][p]  [/p][p][/p][p][b]Assasin[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30239964/8286895735893284f15e8d0d65b3fb61487a1821.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Static shock[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30239964/cb97f2bf82b00441b023e245189f1f993f118909.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Trapper[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30239964/84d7298707965bd871ad70d1da86470f88bafe4d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Vampire[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30239964/258d1e01fb1585a4fb38bdc4d247c0f8898246cc.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Summon Wall[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30239964/e8997865c7f822055bbe6e82594fefbfb0fc45e6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]In addition to these VFX, we have also enhanced the VFX of all items that are dropped by enemies.[/p][p]These VFX are colour-coded according to item category. notes.title: Update Showcase: Modifiers Part 2
notes.notes:
Hello again, the next update is just around the corner, so we wanted to give you an idea of what to expect.

We have added 2 new modifiers and associated abilities, these are the Vampire and Static Shock modifiers.

The Static Shock modifier is designed to spice up the play style of the game, when an enemy with it takes ranged damage they will fire 2 projectiles that will bounce off nearby walls and floors (take a shield), when they take melee damage they will damage the player for 1 damage, after taking damage they will go on a cooldown. Enemies with the Vampire modifier will periodically fire a projectile that will restore some of their health, so keep your distance. After the projectile is fired, the ability will cooldown.

notes.title: Modifier System
notes.notes:
[b]The Modifier System[/b]
The currently planned modifiers include things like: 
[list]
[*] Trap re-arming 
[*] Static Shock
[*] Wall Summons
[*] Vampiric lifesteal
[/list]

Traps are currently a one-off danger, Enemies with this modifier will be capable of re-arming them. This will make the environment more dangerous if you're not careful.

Some enemies will fire projectiles at the player if they're hit, this is intended to reduce double-weapon use of ranged weapons.

There will also be enemies capable of spawning walls around the player, cutting off possible escape routes.

Finally, some enemies will heal after dealing damage to the player.

We will be going into more detail on each of these as development continues.

For now, the developers wish you a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!

notes.title: Update day!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

This update has a lot of quality of life updates and major technical/performance updates. Many bugs have been fixed and almost every aspect of the game has been polished.

Some highlights are:

We have greatly improved loading times, especially between loops. This also fixes a bug where a player would be thrown back to the lobby while the game was loading.

We have improved the combat system and polished combat elements, e.g. enemies have a new death animation and overall all weapons feel better to use.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30239964/144ad09561227aab453a968864979d0bd9c7e684.gif[/img]

We improved the visuals of the environments and added new effects to some objects, e.g. destructibles such as crates and vases have now physics and it feels better to destroy them. We also improved the lightning.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30239964/512ddfeee4c11162795225eb1e4c5a3cd122bab5.gif[/img]

We support now the valve index controllers. We fixed the oculus controllers and improved the locomotion system. 

We have now a networked lobby, which is not limited to a region. This means if you are connected to the internet and start the game, there is a chance to see other players in the lobby. You can invite players to a group and play with them. We have implemented a reconnect system in case someone disconnects. We still support drop in multiplayer.

---

We wish you all a lot of fun!

Patch Notes:

- Improved loading times (game startup & ingame)
- Improved Performance
- Improved item interactions -> picking up, etc.
- Valve Index Controller Support
- Fixed Oculus Touch Controlls
- Better Enemy Death Animations
- Better Weapon handling (hand position, effects, etc.)
- Improved VFX (Weapons, Projectiles, Companions, Enemies)
- Networked Lobby

notes.title: Current state

We haven't posted an announcement for a while now, but we are still here.

notes.notes:
Today we have prepared a content update.

Many of you probably know certain rooms already good enough and are not surprised by traps or enemy positions. With the new rooms the dungeons/levels feel completely new again!

In addition to the new rooms we included the achievements system into the game, there are 30 achievements.

You can see all achievements here:
http://steamcommunity.com/stats/686360/achievements

It is possible now to unlock custom cosmetic outfits. Upon completing a certain achievement you will be able to choose an outfit in the hub area.

The achievements which grant a cosmetic outfit are not hidden.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30239964/3eb34e4eed2fb90745ec197dbc1465f1afe64a45.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30239964/24f1b091571bf3246982b9ef6f168d97c48e34da.jpg[/img]

Some people told us that the trackpad locomotion is too slow. It feels really slow especially if you played an other game with trackpad locomotion before.

So we added a new locomotion option for this. You can now adjust the speed of trackpad locomotion (the current speed is 2.5):

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30239964/07496de8124a26a7c119d5f83995426b66914d6d.jpg[/img]

Have fun playing the game and let is know what you think! We will always try to do our best and improve the game!

Update:

[list]
    [*]Added 30 achievements
    [*]Added 81 new rooms
    [*]Added 10 cosmetic outfits (unlocked by completing achievements)
    [*]Player movementspeed is now adjustable in the locomotion menu
[/list]

notes.title: Difficulties, Combat System, Bug Fixes and More
notes.notes:
We have been listening to you all and a few things needed to be changed. So here are the changes:

We improved the melee combat system, the melee weapon now has more range and deals more damage. The scaling for swinging and wiggle have been improved as well. Wiggle has now a small cooldown. Both playstyles are now strong enough to finish the enemies and bosses. The boss loses now health if his summoned enemies are damaged.

We also added region select for multiplayer. There was an issue that people could not find each other, they were on their best region. Now if you want to play with a friend:

[b]Make sure you both select the same region and have the same game name.[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30239964/7893a9c4fea9de6f74b8273ccf9295ec486c9c76.jpg[/img]

We added difficulty settings for single player. Difficulties can now be found on the terminal for single player.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30239964/59d9fa9fde3520002b42da708d34a2d5f79a289c.jpg[/img]

There is now a new interface for menu, locomotion etc.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30239964/3d15ae573a4ef2b181570c2cba66626eece3e969.jpg[/img]

We also fixed a multiplayer issue, where people would crash while looping into the second area.

Update:

[list]
    [*]Player is now invurnable for a short time after getting hit
    [*]Damage to summoned enemies now also deals damage to the summoner (relevant for boss fights)
    [*]Increased range of melee weapons
    [*]Improved AI to not let enemies walk into you
    [*]Increased melee base damage and damage scaling when swinging
    [*]Improved player hitbox to allow easier blocking with shield
    [*]Adjusted enemy health scaling
    [*]Singleplayer: Game difficulty selection
    [*]Multiplayer: Possible to select region for private lobby (all wanting to join need to set the same region)
    [*]Multiplayer: Made gameplay more stable (no more crashes on area switch)
    [*]Multiplayer: Reduced player respawn time from 120 sec to 60 sec
[/list]

notes.title: Multiplayer Revive Feature
notes.notes:
It happens that your team member will die early on in the run and he will become a ghost.

The only options to revive your team member were either finishing the area or finding an ankh (Use Item). Often the dead player had to wait for a long time until he can continue play.

Now it is possible to revive your team member after two minutes!

If a player is dead, he will still become a ghost. He will have a black heart, which slowly becomes red. This takes 2 minutes. A particle will indicate whether the heart is fully charged.

If the heart is fully charged, the living player can activate it by touching it and the dead player will be revived.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30239964/ced59820cb32a93b31ec5a382cc06bbeeea6bc58.gif[/img]

Update notes:

- Multiplayer: Possible to revive dead player after 120 seconds by touching his heart

- Improved multiplayer region selection for a better overall ping

If a player is dead, he will still become a ghost. He will have a black heart, which slowly becomes red. This takes 2 minutes. A particle will indicate whether the heart is fully charged.

If the heart is fully charged, the living player can activate it by touching it and the dead player will be revived.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30239964/ced59820cb32a93b31ec5a382cc06bbeeea6bc58.gif[/img]

Update notes:

- Multiplayer: Possible to revive dead player after 120 seconds by touching his heart

- Improved multiplayer region selection for a better overall ping

notes.title: Save & Load System and Release
notes.notes:
Today is the big day! Dungeons & Treasure VR will be released. Thank you all for the support and the feedback. We hope all of you will have a lot of fun playing the game. Please consider leaving an honest review or feedback on steam. This will help us grow and improve the game.

We have also added one important additional feature to the game: 
You can now save your game progress with save & exit. For now saving the game only works in singleplayer.

notes.title: Working on more content: weapons, items, upgrades
notes.notes:
We are making some good progress. We started to add more content to the game which will be unlockable with the special currency which can be aquired by killing a stage boss. 

In the starting lobby you will find a special room, where you can see all weapons etc. and unlock them. The unlocked weapons etc. can then be found in the next playthrough.

We are experimenting with some abilities for melee weapons. We want to buff melee weapons with an active skill.

We plan to implement around 100 passive upgrades and around 40 different items, weapons and shields for the release.

For more details on what we are currently working on check this youtube video:

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vzKI3aU2-98] YouTube Video[/url]

Also here are some more quick impressions:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30239964/6b74851c60245c9c0e6b99c79c3cdb321be6581a.gif[/img]
Bomb upgrade, every 10th hit triggers an explosion. Can be stacked until every hit triggers an explosion.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30239964/17f8c960001a5139705508e903bc34db85e8d7de.gif[/img]
Active sword skill increases range of the sword for a certain amount of time.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30239964/fc26d9933b383e59e4b5cff9d707fe67318a751b.gif[/img]
Active sword skill, which enables you to throw projectiles if the sword is swung strong enough.

notes.title: Updating demo! Lobby, Improved networking, locomotions and more
notes.notes:
We decided to update the demo. In this update we improved networking and added the lobby. Every player starts in the lobby and can either enter a single player game, a multiplayer game or create/join a private lobby.

- added lobby
- added mute button to menu
- added return to lobby button to menu
- imporved networking
- added hand locomotion
- added use item
- added destructable vases in hallways
- added another ranged weapon
- added pick up cooldown for items which are dropped by enemies or
found in chests (so you dont instantly pick them up)
- added visual indicator for interactions like dropping weapons/items 
and buying items from the shopkeeper
